name: Akroma, Angel of Fury — firing its own activated ability does not overflow the stack
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. _isProtectedFromSource resolved an ability pseudo-perm's real source by calling Battlefield.getAllFinalStates() from inside evaluation; with the cache not yet populated that re-entered the pipeline and recursed forever whenever the affected creature had any protection. effectAppliesToPerm now passes the in-progress states down. Akroma (protection from white and from blue) fires '{R}: gets +1/+0' and must end up 7/6.

call: this card gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
{R}: this card gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
